blind.description: A fantasy or dungeon puzzle pressure plate consisting of a square dark stone frame, an inner mossy green ring, and a raised circular stone disc button carved with a stylized spiral motif around a central circular depression. Surfaces are solid, smooth, and stylized with clean beveled edges and continuous geometry. The model sits flat on the ground with no floating or distorted parts.
blind.from_above: A square dark grey border framing a concentric circular structure: an outer olive-green ring enclosing a tan disc carved with an asymmetrical teardrop/spiral groove surrounding central concentric circles.
blind.height_vs_figure: About 4 to 6 inches tall (barely ankle-height on the 5 ft 9 in figure) and approximately 2.5 to 3 feet wide and deep.
